model_fields.description: Positive core bootstrap-schema version used to decode and validate the complete closed manifest before any asset is opened. Unknown versions are rejected; fields from another version are never ignored.
Stable canonical namespaced pack identifier whose uniqueness is enforced within an installation. It conveys no authenticated publisher ownership.
Exact normalized SemVer 2.0.0 version permanently bound to one canonical manifest digest. Build metadata is preserved as part of the exact coordinate even though SemVer precedence ignores it.

Non-empty duplicate-free ordered set of complete `EmbeddingProfile` definitions, canonically ordered by `embedding_profile_id`. Each stored `profile_digest` is recomputed before installation may continue.
Non-empty complete ordered set of `ModelPackAssetEntry` values. Every declared entry is mandatory and canonical ordering follows the asset-entry contract below.

Non-empty complete ordered set of `ModelPackRuntimeRequirement` values needed to render, segment, generate, and infer for every embedded profile. Requirements can only select components already shipped with the target Urdira engine.

Digest of exactly the six preceding fields under `core:model_pack_manifest_digest`; the digest field itself and all delivery metadata are omitted. Urdira recomputes it before collision checks or asset acquisition.
Digest of visible artifacts, versions, and tombstones.
Digest of the complete visible canonical record set.
Digest of snapshot-wide capability coverage and limitations.
UCE digest governed by `core:snapshot_digest`; its positive field list and referenced set digests are authoritative in the core digest-field registry.
Digest of non-content metadata capable of affecting analysis.

Complete `IntentRecipeDefinition` in declared field order with `recipe_digest` absent. Stage order is topological and semantic; capability, ranking, guard, and pagination-stream collections use their registered canonical identifier order.

payload_fields.description: The canonical request pointer naming the budget whose supplied value is outside the operation's advertised bounds.
The supplied numeric budget value that failed the selected operation's bounds.
The non-negative pending observation count for each workspace, in the same order as workspace_ids.
The elapsed non-negative wait in milliseconds before the freshness boundary expired.
The optional non-negative server estimate in milliseconds before another freshness attempt may make progress.
The non-empty closed set of embedding-profile dimensions that failed hard compatibility checks.
